title: Preparation and culture of bone marrow-derived macrophages from mice for functional analysis
protocol: Euthanize mouse by an appropriate method approved by the supervising institution.
Soak the euthanized mouse with 70% ethanol.
Remove skin to expose lower limb.
Cut major muscles near the base of the lower limb to expose the hip joint.
Cut femur near its base.
Cut Achilles tendon and remove major muscles around tibia.
Remove major muscles around femur.
Cut at knee joint.
Remove major muscles around tibia, and remove fibula.
Remove the epiphyses of femur and tibia to access the bone marrow with a 23G needle.
Inject approximately 2–3 mL PBS per bone into each end to wash out the bone marrow.
Centrifuge the bone marrow suspension at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Decant or aspirate the PBS from the centrifuged sample.
Resuspend in 1× lyse buffer on ice and let sit for 3 minutes (optional).
Add 10 mL DMEM (10% FBS, 1% penicillin streptomycin) to resuspended cells and centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Repeat the erythrocyte removal step if necessary.
Resuspend bone marrow (approximately 1 × 10^7 live cells per mouse) in 1 mL bone marrow culture medium.
Filter the resuspended bone marrow through a 100 μm cell strainer.
Pipette suspension (approx. 1 × 10^7 live cells) into total volume of bone marrow culture medium (approx. 12 mL for 12 well plate).
Add bone marrow culture medium to wells (1 mL/well for 12 well plate).
Culture at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Add half this volume of bone marrow culture medium on day 4 (e.g., 500 μL/well for 12 well plate).
Wash cells with sterile PBS.
Change to DMEM 10% FBS and continue culture at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Optional: Change to DMEM without FBS if not already changed.
Change medium to DMEM without FBS (2 h before in vitro experiment).
Change medium in BMDM cultures to the stimulation medium of interest.
Wash cells twice with PBS and aspirate.
Add 0.05% trypsin-EDTA (approx. 100 μL/well for 12 well plate) and incubate at 37°C for 3 min.
Add DMEM (10% FBS, 1 mL/well for 12 well plate), dislodge cells using a cell scraper, and transfer to a 5 mL round bottom tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g, 4°C for 3 min.
Suspend cells in 1 mL FACS buffer for counting and subsequent analysis.
Freeze washed culture plate with liquid nitrogen if sampling of protein or RNA takes place later.
Add extraction buffer directly to the wells and pipette repeatedly until no adherent cells remain.
Sonicate cell lysis buffer supplemented with 1× protease cocktail (approx. 100 μL/well for a 12 well plate) for 5 min at 4°C, then vortex.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 10,000 × g and transfer supernatant to a 1.5 mL sampling tube.
Avoid aspirating or contacting the sediment.
Add 1/3 volume of 4× Laemmli buffer to the protein sample and boil for 10 min.
Keep samples at -20°C until SDS-PAGE.
Add 350 μL buffer RLT to the wells for RNA extraction using the RNeasy mini kit.
Elute RNA with 50-100 μL TE.
Store extracted RNA at -80°C until gene expression analysis.
